assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: WordShift Google Play feature graphic source illustration, wide landscape, approximately 2:1, no promotional typography.
Primary request: Refine the supplied den artwork into an inviting cozy mystery game illustration with a clearer letter-puzzle cue and a quiet nighttime mystery.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and establishes the room, pixel-art style, and overall composition. Image 2 is the actual Ember character reference: preserve this friendly orange fox's cream muzzle, brown paws, proportions, and green knitted sweater. Image 3 is an actual game screenshot, reference only for the warm cream, rounded square letter tiles with dark serif capitals; do not reproduce the UI or its wordmark.
Composition: Keep the left 34 percent mostly quiet dark forest-green wall for later title typesetting. Put the warm fireplace and fox in the middle-right of the composition, Ember seated in the same cozy chair, with a small table and tea. Make the table's letter tiles clearly visible, larger and more legible than in the original. Use four warm cream wooden tiles with just the uppercase letters W, O, R, D, one letter per tile. Preserve generous margins so the fox face, the tiles, and the dark doorway are not cropped by a 1024 by 500 export. A video play overlay may cover the exact center, so do not put the fox face or main tiles there.
Nighttime mystery: Make the open doorway at the right unmistakably dark blue nighttime beyond the firelit room. Let a narrow wash of cool moonlight cross the threshold. The door is ajar and feels quietly curious, suggesting there is more to discover, while the overall scene remains welcoming. No creature, person, or figure in the doorway. No glowing eyes, robes, ritual symbols, graveyard, violence, horror monster, or endgame reveal.
Style: Preserve the handcrafted pixel-art illustration style of Image 1, crisp intentional pixel clusters, warm amber firelight, orange fox, deep forest greens and cool midnight blues, restrained texture. Keep Ember recognizable from the actual sprite in Image 2. No smooth 3D rendering or new branding.
Text: Only the four individual tile letters W O R D. No logo, title, caption, watermark, or other text.
Output: One polished full-bleed wide illustration with opaque background.
assets.intendedUse: Promotional artwork only, not a gameplay screenshot or launcher asset
assets.review: Inspected generated output: faithful Ember character, correct tile lettering, no forbidden spoiler imagery, usable composition.

assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: Google Play app-store icon challenger, a square 1024 by 1024 pixel full-bleed image. This is an icon variation for WordShift.
Primary request: Create a simpler and exceptionally legible small-size variant of the existing WordShift fox-and-W icon while preserving the exact friendly character identity and handcrafted pixel-art branding.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing icon edit target. Image 2 is the actual game sprite for Ember, supporting character identity reference only.
Subject and composition: One friendly orange fox face with cream cheeks and muzzle, black-brown eyes and nose, pointed cream-lined ears, a simple hint of the green knitted sweater at the bottom, and one warm cream wooden letter tile displaying the single dark forest-green uppercase serif letter W. Crop to a clear head-and-shoulders portrait with the face facing the viewer. The head is the dominant shape and occupies the upper and central roughly two-thirds. Make the W tile large, upright, and easily readable at the lower right, with its edge comfortably inside the image, below the eyes so it does not obscure expression. Keep all ears within the canvas and comfortably away from the corners.
Simplification: Fewer larger intentional pixel clusters, a clean readable face, less tiny knitted texture, no tiny scenery, and a single even dark forest-green background. The fox’s face and W should read clearly at 48 pixels. Keep the visual warmth and recognizable Ember expression from the references; don’t turn the fox into another species or a generic flat logo.
Color and style: Pixel-art illustration with crisp square pixel clusters, orange fur, cream muzzle, dark eyes, muted green sweater and background, warm cream tile. Restrained lighting with strong subject-background contrast. Match the existing store-art style but simplify detail.
Text (verbatim): "W", once, uppercase, only on the single tile. No title, other letters, numeral, badge, or watermark.
Constraints: Full square opaque background to all edges. No transparent margins, no rounded outer corners, no outside drop shadow, no frame, no phone mockup. No second tile, no mug, no robes, no sinister expression.
assets.intendedUse: Promotional artwork only, not a gameplay screenshot or launcher asset
assets.review: Inspected generated output: faithful Ember character, correct tile lettering, no forbidden spoiler imagery, usable composition.
